contexts.text: A shining face from the idea of their own holiness.
To make His face to shine () = to have mercy. AE 340:11.
The Divine love shines like a sun.
All truths... shine: truths outside the Heavens do not shine as do those within them; they shine coldly, like snow.
(Such) cannot shine in Heaven, because they are not delighted with the light of Heaven.
Those who have wanted all they thought to be open... in Heaven shine in the face.
When a Spirit rubs his face or garment with the Word, it shines... TCR 209:2.
With these, the Word as it were shines when read.
No need of the sun and moon to shine in it (). Explained.
That all truths of the Word shine... When any verse is written on a paper, and the paper is thrown into the air, it shines... and in this way Spirits can produce various shining forms.
The faith of Truths shines in Heaven like a star.
Every truth in the Word, and from the Word, shines.
That the day should not shine... nor the night () = the light of spiritual and of natural truth extinguished.
That they shall shine as the stars.
